column1: # BlackBerry OS 7.1 sounds the module lays in /product/media/audio (docs/BBOS7-VISUEL.md, section 20).
# Columns: path under /product/media/audio, firmware file under assets-gen/sounds/ (the
# <cod>/<path> of assets-private/bbos7-9900/sounds/, which tools/import-assets.sh copies), title
# shown by the pickers. The directory is the category (ringtones, notifications, alarms: what
# MediaStore classes by path; ui: names fixed by Android). The build keeps the firmware's AAC as it
# is in .m4a (copied, not re-encoded), converts the Sonar WAV to FLAC and the interface sounds to
# Ogg Opus, and writes the title as a tag; it fails if a source is missing. tools/sons.sh reads the
# first column. Titles: the one tagged in the firmware's AAC, trailing space removed (A); the file
# name split before each capital where the firmware has none (D: Sonar and the ui sounds).
# No lock, unlock, keypress, power-on or power-off sound: the 9900 has none that Android could
# play at those moments, so those stay Android's.
# ringtones/: all 34 tones of the 9900 (Ringtones picker, MediaStore is_ringtone).
# notifications/: the tones under 5 s, plus the Sonar tune (Notifications picker).
# alarms/: the tones over 5 s (Alarms picker), and 3Beeps, the timer's.
# ui/: names fixed by Android (low_battery_sound, charging_started_sound, MediaActionSound, NfcService).
